claims.text: Inn by the Sea is located on a mile of sandy beach on the coast of Maine.

findings.quote: Inn by the Sea is located on a mile of sandy beach on the coast of Maine.

claims.text: The inn is in Cape Elizabeth, about a 15-minute drive from downtown Portland, Maine.

findings.quote:
this Cape Elizabeth property a 15-minute drive from downtown
Portland, Maine,

claims.text: Guestrooms and one- or two-bedroom suites have private exterior entrances.

findings.quote: sixty-two guestrooms and one or two-bedroom suites with private exterior entrances

claims.text: Pet-friendly accommodations are offered.

findings.quote: including pet-friendly options

claims.text: The spa offers massages, facials and body treatments, with private relaxation sanctuaries, steam rooms and experience showers.

findings.quote: offers a variety of massages, facials, and body treatments, complemented by private relaxation sanctuaries, steam rooms, and experience showers

claims.text: The resort has an outdoor swimming pool and private cabanas.

findings.quote: outdoor swimming pool, private cabanas, and direct access to beautiful Crescent Beach

claims.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and on-demand fitness classes.

findings.quote: our fitness center, featuring modern cardio and strength-training equipment, Peloton bikes, and on-demand fitness classes

claims.text: All of the property's clean electricity comes from solar, and there are composting programs for guests.

findings.quote: green energy (100% of the property’s clean electricity comes from solar), and composting programs for guests

claims.text: The inn runs environmental programs and long-term commitments to restore the surrounding land, with green design throughout.

findings.quote: with environmental programs, long-term commitments to restore the land it around it, and green design throughout

claims.text: On property there are weekly Beach Ecology Walks, Garden Tours and Great Pond Walks.

findings.quote: On property, we offer a variety of ways to experience Cape Elizabeth with weekly Beach Ecology Walks, Garden Tours, Great Pond Walks

claims.text: Sea Glass, the restaurant, uses ingredients from Maine farms and fishermen.

findings.quote: Our restaurant features the freshest ingredients from land and sea provided by the wonderful farms and fisherman of the great state of Maine.

claims.text: The inn partners with BabyQuip so families can rent baby gear.

findings.quote: we have partnered with BabyQuip to make your family travel at Inn by the Sea a breeze

claims.text: Crescent Beach, a salt-water beach with relatively warm water, is reached from the inn by a private boardwalk.

findings.quote: Relatively warm water at  this classic salt-water beach is just a private boardwalk away

claims.text: Garden suites and loft suites in the main house often have two floors, Atlantic views, private decks and kitchenettes.

findings.quote: newly designed garden suites and loft suites in the main house—many have two floors and dramatic views of the Atlantic, private decks, equipped kitchenettes

claims.text: Beach suites can have views of Crescent Beach, a private outdoor patio, a fully equipped kitchen, a gas fireplace, a steam shower and an extra-large bathtub.

findings.quote: soothing views of Sandy Crescent Beach, a private outdoor patio, a fully equipped kitchen, gas burning fireplace, steam shower and an extra-large bathtub

claims.text: Spa treatments use marine-based skincare products with seaweed extracts and marine peptides.

findings.quote: marine-based skincare products rich in rejuvenating seaweed extracts, marine peptides

claims.text: Daily morning yoga is a mixed-level class for adults, overlooking the Atlantic.

findings.quote: Morning Yoga
a mixed level class overlooking the Atlantic. Meet in the fitness center, yoga mats provided. Adults only, available daily.

claims.text: Spa services and amenities are reserved for guests 18 and older; the minimum age for services is 16 when accompanied by an adult.

findings.quote: Minimum age for services is 16 accompanied by guest of 18 years or older. Spa services and amenities are reserved for guests 18 years of age and older.

claims.text: Advance reservations are required for all spa services.

findings.quote: Advance reservations are required for all SPA services.
